statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis is coded as I25.10
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was billed
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic palpitations with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
This diagnostic monitoring service is medically necessary
